strings.用以熟悉协议内容的模式: A mode for getting familiar with the protocol
strings.·仅可使用预置的调配干员: · Only the preset loadout operators can be used
strings.·无法用于解锁策略: · Cannot be used to unlock Strategies
strings.敌方攻击强度较高的模拟训练: A simulation training with stronger enemy attacks
strings.敌方攻击强度极高的模拟训练: A simulation training with extremely strong enemy attacks
strings.敌方攻击强度到达极限的模拟训练: A simulation training where enemy attacks are at their limit
strings.敌方攻击强度较低的模拟训练: A simulation training with weaker enemy attacks
strings.对敌方领袖造成伤害最高（仅胜利时）: Highest damage dealt to the Enemy Leader (victory only)
strings.激活的盟约层数总和最高: Highest total of activated alliance layers
strings.只有在联合模拟中才能获得奖杯: Trophies can only be earned in Alliance Simulation
strings.联合模拟在选择策略时可以进行一次跳过: In Alliance Simulation, you can skip once when choosing a Strategy
strings.归属于特定盟约的干员只有部分会出现在调度中心内: Only some of the operators belonging to a given alliance appear in the Dispatch Center
strings.调度中心即使冻结，依然可以主动刷新: You can still refresh the Dispatch Center manually even while it is frozen
strings.晋级的特殊奖励无法被刷新、冻结，也不会保留至下一回合: Special promotion rewards cannot be refreshed or frozen, and are not kept until the next round
strings.处于临时整备区的调度资源，在进入下一回合后会自动销毁: Dispatch resources in the Temporary Reserve are destroyed automatically when the next round begins
strings.一些特殊的盟约不需要部署干员也能激活生效: Some special alliances can be activated without deploying operators
strings.干员晋级后已配发装备会回收至整备区，需要重新配置: When an operator is promoted, its equipped gear is returned to the Reserve and must be equipped again
strings.两件同名装备可以合成一件更强力的装备: Two pieces of gear with the same name can be merged into a stronger piece
strings.特定的装备组合可以为干员赋予额外的盟约效果: Specific gear combinations can grant an operator an extra alliance effect
strings.叠加的盟约会在单次模拟中始终保留，但只有在盟约被激活时才会发挥作用: Stacked alliance layers persist throughout a simulation, but only take effect while the alliance is active
strings.多数情况下只有已经激活的盟约才可进行叠加: In most cases, only alliances that are already active can stack layers
strings.休整期可以查看队友的战场情况: During the Rest Phase you can view your teammates' battlefields
strings.休整期可以查看当前回合即将迎击的敌方单位: During the Rest Phase you can view the enemy units you will face this round
strings.拖拽干员至整备区可以直接撤退干员: Drag an operator to the Reserve to retreat it directly
strings.全体参与者就绪之前可随时取消准备，准备战斗后将无法进行操作: Until all participants are ready you can cancel Ready at any time; once combat is prepared, no actions are possible
strings.只有达成完美作战的队友可以进行联防: Only teammates who achieved a Perfect Combat can take part in the Unite Phase
strings.进行联防时，盟约不会继续叠加: Alliance layers do not keep stacking during the Unite Phase
strings.最终攻势中，两名参与者会处于同一个战场，但无法查看另一组队友的战场情况: In the Final Assault, two participants share one battlefield, but cannot view the other pair's battlefield
strings.最终攻势中，所有人将一起对敌方领袖造成伤害: In the Final Assault, everyone deals damage to the Enemy Leader together
strings.达成特定的条件，可在最终攻势后解锁隐秘核心: Meet specific conditions to unlock the Hidden Core after the Final Assault
